item.title: Gov’t begins disbursement of financial aid to Jamaicans whose homes were damaged or destroyed by Hurricane Melissa
item.description: Under the Restoration of Owner, or Occupant Family Shelters (ROOFS) Programme, payments for severe damage, valued at up to $500,000, have officially commenced. Speaking at a handing over ceremony, at the Social Security Ministry's, Santa Cruz Office in St. Elizabeth today, Prime Minister Dr. Andrew Holness said, 50 beneficiaries have received assistance, through the ministry’s digital voucher modality.
